title: Noetherian polynomial local complete-intersection regularity
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $f_1,\ldots,f_c\in P=R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ define a specified relative global complete intersection [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection]. If $Q$ is a prime of $P$ containing the ideal of the equations, the images of the equations form a regular sequence in $P_Q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence].

source.place: 00SV first paragraph, flat local map and 00MG lifting.

proof.text: The polynomial ring is free and hence flat over R, and is Noetherian. The canonical local map R_p to P_Q is flat and local; both localizations are Noetherian.
The closed-fibre equations are regular by the closed-fibre regularity theorem. Apply Grothendieck regular-sequence lifting and take its regularity conjunct.

theorem isRegular_localization_of_relativeCompleteIntersection_of_noetherian
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {n c : ℕ}
    (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (h : IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersectionPresentation f)
    (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) [Q.IsPrime]
    (hQ : Ideal.span (Set.range f) ≤ Q) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime Q)
      ((List.ofFn f).map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.AtPrime Q)))
